summary: WTB Thm 12 and Thm 19 are now cited with the right theorem numbers, and the draft does avoid the old set-inclusion and super-receiver routes, but it still fails the R0.2 bar because the v0.4 cross-task transfer is reintroduced in substance: Lemma γ.B.1/γ.B.3 and the combined chain again claim an Alice-Bob umr key-rate bound from an Alice-Charlie single-edge bound without a proved operational reduction. Independent of that, Lemma γ.B.2 contains invalid mutual-information steps, the Khatri-Wilde Prop. 19.2 citation is misdescribed, and γ.B.2/γ.4 are partially upgraded to CLOSE despite the stated 'no upgrade without C1+C2+C3' rule.

issues.description: The forbidden v0.4 cross-task transfer is back. The combined chain asserts `R <= log K_A-B <= E_R^epsilon(E1)`, and the body already makes the same move at lines 89 and 146-147 ('Alice-Bob extractable key rate <= Alice-Charlie bound', 'K is bounded by Alice-Charlie correlation'). That is exactly the unproved Alice-Bob-to-Alice-Charlie transfer that v0.4 had explicitly downgraded and ruled out.
issues.suggestion: Delete every AB<=AC-style step from γ.B.1, γ.B.3, and the combined chain. Keep the operational reduction as an open target lemma until it is proved within one consistent task/state model, rather than stating the transfer in paraphrased form.

issues.description: Lemma γ.B.2 uses a mathematically unsupported DPI chain. From `I(A : B(Â,B̂)) <= I(A : Â,B̂)` one cannot conclude `I(A : Â,B̂) <= I(A : Â)` without an additional independence/Markov argument, and the next step `I(A : E1(A')) <= E_R(E1)` at line 122 is false or unsupported as stated because quantum mutual information is not generally upper-bounded by relative entropy of entanglement.
issues.suggestion: Rewrite γ.B.2 around a monotone that actually matches the desired converse quantity, or leave the lemma open. Do not rely on the current mutual-information reduction or the `I <= E_R` claim.

issues.description: The Khatri-Wilde citation is overstated and misdescribed. The local memo gives Prop. 19.2 as an n-shot LOCC-assisted communication converse `E(M_A;M_B)_ω <= n E^A(N)` and Cor. 19.3 as the tele-simulable reduction; it does not state the blanket proposition used here that 'any LOCC-compatible entanglement measure is monotone under LOCC'. The same overclaim is reused for γ.4 at line 204, while Cor. 19.3 is not actually described in the proof body.
issues.suggestion: Restate Prop. 19.2 and Cor. 19.3 only in their actual amortized-entanglement / tele-simulable forms, or downgrade these references to recalled/open until the exact transfer from those results to the γ lemmas is written out.

issues.description: The draft silently upgrades lemma status despite the stated R0.2 discipline. γ.B.2 is labeled '[CONJ-DRAFT -> CLOSE]' and γ.4 is labeled '[STANDARD, close]' plus '[CLOSE]' at line 207, even though §9.3 says C1+C2+C3 is the only legal upgrade path and §11 says the file stays '[CONJ-DRAFT] throughout' except for textbook corollaries.
issues.suggestion: Keep γ.B.2 and γ.4 explicitly as draft-only, e.g. '[CONJ-DRAFT, textbook-closable]' or '[OPEN, low-risk]'. Reserve any CLOSE/CLOSED label for after the promised verification path is actually completed.

issues.description: §9.1 understates the remaining work. γ.B.2 is not realistically a '~0.5 day textbook close' in its current form because its proof sketch still depends on the broken `I(A:Â,B̂) <= I(A:Â)` and `I <= E_R` steps. That makes the Phase 1 / Phase 2 split too optimistic as written.
issues.suggestion: Revise the workload split so Phase 1 contains only genuinely textbook-stable items, and move γ.B.2 out of the 'closable in half a day' bucket unless its proof route is replaced first.

round_recommendation: First remove the reintroduced Alice-Bob <= Alice-Charlie transfer from γ.B.1/γ.B.3 and the combined chain, then rebuild γ.B.2 with a valid converse monotone and downgrade γ.B.2/γ.4 back to draft-only status. After that, rerun the citation audit specifically against WTB Thm 12/19 and Khatri-Wilde Prop. 19.2 / Cor. 19.3.
